items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: It was a local band named Chuck Cabot, and he was a — also he was coach of high school.

ctx.x: They were supportive. They were concerned the first time I went on the road at 16, and my father gave me a talk about girls. And the war was still on then, because this was in 1944. And things were in short supply, certain things. And one of them were white dress shirts. And I needed them for this, which I didn’t have because I never had jobs before. So my mother went all over and ended up finding me six white shirts, but one here, one there, whatever. And they were quite concerned when they packed me up and sent…
It was a local band named Chuck Cabot, and he was a — also he was coach of high school. And his brother was Johnny Richards.
